title: Potato Soup
description: A creamy, herb-forward potato soup built on a mirepoix base with garlic and shallot, finished with whole milk, evaporated milk, and a warm spice blend. Low-and-slow simmering keeps it from scorching. Mash to your preferred texture.

steps.text: Add the cooked {i09}, then {i10}, then {i11}, then {i12} and {i13}, then add {i14}, {i15}, {i16}, {i17}, {i18}, {i19}, {i20}, {i21}, {i22}, {i23}, {i24}, and {i25} if using. Stir to combine.

rawText:
Potato Soup

2 tablespoons butter 
Couple glugs olive oil

1 cup chopped onion
1 cup chopped celery
1 cup chopped carrots
7-8 cloves garlic, minced
Big shallot, minced 
2-3 tablespoons all-purpose flour

4-5 potatoes, quartered (see below)

Couple glugs dry white wine (Sauvignon Blanc)

32 oz. vegetable broth
1 1/2 cups whole milk (can sub up to 1/2 cup with heavy cream if you’re feeling spicy)
12 oz. can evaporated milk

Handful chopped fresh parsley
Handful chopped fresh dill 

2 teaspoons Worcestershire sauce
1 1/2 teaspoons mustard powder
1 pinch ground allspice
1 teaspoon celery seed
1/2 teaspoon dried thyme
1 teaspoon seasoning salt
1/2 teaspoon sea salt (+ more to taste)
1 teaspoon black pepper
Dash cayenne pepper
Couple good pinches of truffle sea salt (optional but so good)

Cook potatoes
	⁃	Put quartered potatoes in big pot. Cover with water. Salt it good. Cover and bring to a boil. Reduce and simmer for ~15 min. Strain. Set aside. 

Heat butter and oil in same big pot over medium high. Add garlic, shallot, onions and let them go for a few minutes. Add celery and carrots for a few more. Add flour and stir it up real good. Add potatoes, then the wine, broth, and milks, then everything else.
Let it simmer on super low (or else it will burn to the bottom of the pot) for at least half an hour. Mash the potatoes as much as you want. Add more broth if it’s too thick.
